messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: CRITICAL: p95 latency spike detected for inference-cluster eu-west-1 starting ~1746509600. Alerting oncall.
oncall-erin: I got the page, looking. Any ongoing deploys?
dmitri: No user-triggered deploys in the last hour per CI event logs.
kai: I see a host kernel update rolled out in the last 10m: kernel-5.15.0-123 -> 5.15.0-124 via unattended patching. Scheduling group shows ~60% of hosts updated in eu-west-1.
oncall-erin: can you paste the rollout job id?
kai: job/infra-kernel-update-2026-03-17-0203.
infra-bot: Deploy job job/infra-kernel-update-2026-03-17-0203 completed on 37/60 hosts in eu-west-1 at 1746509402.
dmitri: Perf counters from a hot host (post-update):
```
# perf stat -a -e cpu-clock,task-clock,context-switches,cpu-migrations,cycles,instructions,branches,branch-misses -I 1000 sleep 10
1000,12345,2345,56,3,123456789,987654321,123456,456
```
High context-switch rate compared to baseline. Runqueue length increased (rq_len avg 4.3 -> 9.8).
oncall-erin: traces? any long spans in sleuth?
maria: Uploading a trace snippet from request id req-89ab: 1746509805
```
TRACE req-89ab
- dispatch (5ms)
- model_kv_cache_get (2ms)
- worker_queue_wait (86ms)
- kernel-sched-sleep (80ms)
- token_gen (12ms)
```
Looks like delays in worker_queue_wait -> kernel scheduler.
sarah: Customers impacted: several mid-market tenants in eu-west-1 reported timeouts between 17:34 - 17:45 UTC, approx 0.9% of overall requests. CS alerted.
oncall-erin: immediate mitigation options: 1) pause or rollback kernel rollout 2) shift incoming traffic away from updated hosts 3) increase worker threads to reduce queueing 4) scale Dedicated pools. Thoughts?
kai: Quick patch: add a taint to updated hosts to remove them from inference autoscaler pool, then re-drain. Command: `kubectl label nodes -l kernel=5.15.0-124 taint=infer:NoSchedule`
dmitri: I can run a canary rollback on 6 hosts to kernel-5.15.0-123. If we see p95 drop there, it's likely causal.
oncall-erin: do the taint first to stop new work landing on updated hosts. Maria coordinate customer comms.
maria: Drafting comms now: short note saying we saw increased latency, mitigation in progress, ETA 30-45m.
infra-bot: Taint applied to 37 hosts: `taint=infer:NoSchedule` at 1746510102. New pods rescheduled.
kai: Rolling back kernel package on 6 canary hosts now (job/infra-kernel-rollback-canary-1746510120).
dmitri: Also capturing perf samples pre/post rollback: `perf record -F 99 -a -g -- sleep 30` and `perf script` -> flamegraph. I'll attach when available.
(6m later)
dmitri: Canary results: p95 on canary hosts dropped from 210ms -> 28ms. Runqueue avg back to 3.1. Perf flame shows major stack in `kernel/sched` before rollback.
oncall-erin: good signal. Kai can we stop rollout and revert remaining hosts?
kai: Stopping update: job canceled 1746511200. Rolling rollback plan to revert remaining 31 hosts; ETA ~35m.
sarah: CS updated: customers in eu-west-1 notified, we're routing traffic away from updated hosts; ask them to retry in 30m; no data loss. :white_check_mark:
maria: Logging incident for postmortem, collecting timeline and artifacts: kernel package id, job ids, trace ids, perf outputs, customer impact window.
dmitri: Hypotheses tracked in-thread: H1: kernel scheduler change in 5.15.0-124 increased contention for inference worker threads -> higher runqueue and p95. H2: unrelated IO/driver change coincident with rollout. Evidence so far favors H1 (canary rollback improved).
oncall-erin: Action items: 1) full rollback completion + validation (kai) 2) expand perf checks across all zones (dmitri) 3) add alert for post-deploy p95 delta > 30% (sarah/infra) 4) add kernel-version tag to inference telemetry (maria) 5) run regression test for high-concurrency queueing in staging with kernel-5.15.0-124 (dmitri).
kai: Full rollback complete at 1746513300 on remaining hosts.
infra-bot: Hosts reverted: 31. Cluster p95 trending down.
oncall-erin: Observed cluster-wide p95 back to baseline (p95 29ms) at 1746513360.
maria: Final comms sent to affected customers at 1746513380.
dmitri: Saving perf artifacts to /artifacts/incidents/1746509876/ for RCA. Will attach flamegraphs and perf scripts.
oncall-erin: Thanks everyone. We'll run a follow-up RCA doc with timeline, perf graphs, and remediation (block kernel rollout or add canary/metric gate). Closing the page but handing to postmortem owners (maria + dmitri). :bow:
